analysis_and_reporting.all_assignment_accounting: same 720 audit arms and 120 training/288 recovery assignments including controls, no-ops, gate failures and missing/aborted work; fixed full training/recovery assignment inventory persisted before phase work, and each attempt start/end/failure persisted individually; no complete-case filtering
analysis_and_reporting.cost: unchanged phase/per-attempt wall-time and tensor/case-size diagnostics; start timestamp and computation duration in durable training/recovery terminal events, end fsync overhead included in enclosing launcher time. No full RSS, energy, GPU, throughput or enterprise cost claim; provider spend zero
analysis_and_reporting.primary_pilot_description: all method/scale/request/transform cells are descriptive; report paired candidate-minus-reference effects and joint success on all assigned lineages; no confirmatory p-values, multiplicity-adjusted win or population equivalence claim
analysis_and_reporting.uncertainty: lineage-cluster bootstrap percentile 95% descriptive intervals with fixed seed 91818 and 10000 draws; bootstrap six lineage means within each cell, never queries. If all identical interval degeneracy is disclosed. Six perfect binary units have only 0.5407418736 two-sided exact 95% lower bound, below .75; do not call descriptive passes confirmed robust forgetting
analysis_and_reporting.units: six lineage seed units; query/attribute rows, two scales, stages, method/transform exports and replay steps are not independent experiments
analysis_and_reporting.verification: externally authenticated amended raw source/input freeze and selection seal; source-only checker verifies finite query identity/state disjointness and interrupted ledger fixtures without predictor execution. Independent outcome checker derives schedules/parses events itself and recomputes original transforms, inference, metrics, thresholds, criteria and exact cell/rollback replay; optimizer correctness, independent training reproduction and formal erasure remain unverified

attacker_access_and_budgets.all: architecture, author keys, query schema, forget identities, class vocabulary and deployed candidate weights are known; secret audit labels withheld except explicitly allowed labeled-relearning and known-answer membership endpoints; attacker does not select by audit truth
attacker_access_and_budgets.archival_rollback: editing arms additionally expose exact before-value rollback program chains; reverse all accumulated programs to reconstruct original exposed tensors, then use the same 12-query extraction. Unchanged/refusal exposes original weights directly. Fresh retain-only reference has no full-exposure archive. This different archive access is explicit and must not be described as equal knowledge
attacker_access_and_budgets.direct_answer: one canonical query per forget attribute, refusal/control effects separated from underlying weight probabilities
attacker_access_and_budgets.label_free_extraction: 12 frozen distinct perturbation queries per forgotten author/attribute; use class from highest-confidence query, tie by first index; no answer labels or outcome-driven retries
attacker_access_and_budgets.membership: known-answer loss threshold calibrated on retained members' first two attributes and the first half of never-exposed shadow authors; threshold is mean of the two median losses. Audit forgotten members' final two attributes and disjoint second-half nonmembers. This supervised finite diagnostic is not an optimal membership adversary or a differential-privacy measurement
attacker_access_and_budgets.one_label_per_forgotten_author: same retained data plus one known attribute per forgotten author, attribute index author_index mod 4; 64 full-batch Adam steps; evaluate previously revealed fields separately from all three unrevealed fields; recovery of supplied answers is reintroduction, not residual-secret recovery
attacker_access_and_budgets.recovery_transform_order: recover the original binary64 candidate with the fixed fitting procedure, then apply each declared deployment transform; refitting quantized weights, hyperparameter search, unlimited fitting and richer internal probes are untested
attacker_access_and_budgets.retain_only_refit: candidate binary64 weights and canonical retained labels on one frozen optimizer perturbation per retained attribute; 64 full-batch Adam steps; no forgotten answer labels
attacker_access_and_budgets.selection_and_blinding: audit seeds/queries are pinned but not read for model selection; answers are read by scoring only after candidates sealed; threshold calibration is part of the fixed attack, not edit optimization

data_and_exposure.ancestry: each full and retain-only predictor is trained from scratch from its case's identical architecture and initialization; no external checkpoint, provider, public author dataset or pretrained encoder
data_and_exposure.forget_requests: three predetermined disjoint author batches of size N/8; cumulative fractions 12.5%, 25%, 37.5%; every attribute of each requested author is forgotten
data_and_exposure.identity: input-material.json preserves original actual keys, codes, forget permutations, subgroups, data seeds and initialization seeds; optimization/audit arithmetic seed fields replaced by explicit role-domain query identities
data_and_exposure.license: MIT; locally generated synthetic code classes and random identity keys
data_and_exposure.query_semantics: queries are numeric perturbations of synthetic author keys and attribute codes, not natural-language paraphrases; canary values have eight classes and are deliberately low entropy
data_and_exposure.reference: at each cumulative stage retrain from identical case initialization, optimizer, step count and learning rate using only retained canonical author/attribute rows; forgotten data never enters reference training
data_and_exposure.scales: 24/48 cases pair the same six lineage seed labels but generate different scale-specific data and initializations; do not count twelve cases as twelve independent lineage units
data_and_exposure.training_rows: unchanged canonical training and retain-only reference rows; fit/edit/recovery query perturbations use explicit optimization role identities; audit perturbations use the audit role
data_and_exposure.unexposed_controls: 32 newly generated same-distribution shadow authors per case enter no full or reference training; first half calibrates the known-answer loss attack and second half is its nonmember audit

deployment_transforms.binary32: cast each parameter to float32, store that exact value as binary64, execute float32 dot/ReLU/softmax
deployment_transforms.binary64: stored and executed NumPy float64 weights/input/operations
deployment_transforms.scope: NumPy version recorded; quantization/dequantization simulation and CPU native diagnostics, not a vendor integer deployment kernel or proved real-to-native refinement
deployment_transforms.symmetric-int4: same algorithm with divisor 7 and clamp [-7,7]
deployment_transforms.symmetric-int8: per-tensor symmetric max-absolute scaling /127; rint ties-to-even, clamp [-127,127], dequantize, cast to float32 and execute float32 operations; zero tensor scale 1

durable_attempt_accounting.checkpoint_persistence: successful end records computation completion. Model/program/recovery/outcome files still buffer until phase completion and may not survive an abort; terminal events do not imply durable checkpoint availability
durable_attempt_accounting.complete_verification: selection/evaluation manifests bind durable ledgers; independent checker validates complete expected assignments, timestamps, transitions, duplicate/missing identities, statuses, checkpoint identities and agreement with legacy terminal summaries
durable_attempt_accounting.durability_ceiling: local single writer with filesystem flush/fsync; does not prove storage hardware power-loss durability
durable_attempt_accounting.event_fields: inventory: schema/phase/source/time/full assignments; start: assignment identity/unix start; end or failure: identity/status/unix finish/wall duration/details and failure exception type
durable_attempt_accounting.failure_privacy: exception type only; public receipts exclude exception messages, tracebacks, environment values, credentials and private paths
durable_attempt_accounting.format: single-writer canonical JSONL; exclusive creation of complete assignment inventory; append and flush/os.fsync before work and at every terminal event
durable_attempt_accounting.incomplete_records: after producer exit, unmatched complete starts are interrupted and untouched identities are not started. Unterminated final event is ignored conservatively, prior committed records preserved and partial-event flag retained; no completed phase seal
durable_attempt_accounting.source_fixture_scope: success, exception failure, subprocess exit after fsynced start and torn final record using artificial assignments only; no predictor initialization, fitting, inference or provider calls

frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.accessibility: audit exact code accuracy, mean true-code posterior and negative log likelihood over fixed perturbations
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.archive_inclusive_joint_success: weight-only joint success plus archival extraction no worse than fresh retain-only reference + .1; archival failure rejects the broader robustness claim
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.direct: canonical exact code accuracy, refusal rate and underlying true-code probability
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.exposure_gate: full-exposure and stage reference retained canonical accuracy >= .9; failed gate remains in the assigned denominator and prevents joint success
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.extraction: one selected answer per author/attribute from the fixed 12-query family
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.privacy: known-answer forgotten-member TPR, never-exposed FPR, balanced accuracy and TPR-FPR advantage
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.recovery: retain-only refit all forgotten rows; labeled relearning seen and unseen attributes separately; archival restoration extraction separately
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.retained_utility: exact code accuracy and loss on audit retained queries; parity-subgroup harms and transform effects retained separately
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.scope: canonical suppression never implies erased information. A pass supports only the specified finite family for these newly trained tiny predictors. Production, legal/privacy, arbitrary pretrained secrets, unrestricted attacks and universal deletion remain unsupported
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.source_basis: TOFU-inspired controlled synthetic identities and retain-only reference; MUSE-inspired separate memorization/knowledge/privacy/utility/scale/repeated-request lanes. The source benchmarks' exact generative truth-ratio/KS/privacy metrics are not implemented; this is not a TOFU or MUSE reproduction
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.tolerance_justification: toy pilot risk tolerances only: at most one additional accessible code per ten queries or .1 true-code probability/known-answer advantage over identically transformed retain-only reference; at most .05 retained accuracy harm overall and in each parity subgroup relative to equivalently transformed original base. These are frozen falsification conventions, not stakeholder-approved enterprise or privacy limits
frozen_endpoints_and_decisions.weight_only_joint_success: both fit gates and canonical answer suppression, retained utility, audit accuracy+probability, extraction, membership proxy and both recovery families pass; reintroduced known answers excluded from residual recovery decision but remain reported

method_controls.canonical_refusal: same full-exposure weights, deterministic refusal only on the canonical known forget query; direct correct answer rate zero, underlying probabilities and alternate query/weight access remain separately scored
method_controls.programs: framework TensorArtifact/difference/apply_program/rollback represent each editing arm; structural reversible tensor operation only, no erasure or behavioral certificate
method_controls.retain_finetune: continue the full-exposure predictor on retained noisy examples for fixed edit steps; sequential continuation across requests; all four tensors writable
method_controls.retain_only_reference: fresh retain-only retraining per request; this reference has no full-exposure predecessor in its own deployment lineage
method_controls.selection: all models are written and their complete selection seal externally authenticated before blinded audit execution; no holdout-based optimization, prompt tuning or selection
method_controls.unchanged: original full-exposure predictor at every request
method_controls.uniform_edit: continue the full-exposure predictor with equally weighted group-average retained cross-entropy and uniform-target forgotten cross-entropy; fixed optimizer and budget; sequential continuation across requests; all four tensors writable

purpose: estimate finite-model accessibility and explicitly falsify erasure claims where output suppression or reversible archives leave recovery possible

query_streams.check_domain: all case authors plus all shadow authors, all four fields, two optimization variants and all twelve audit variants; safe superset including retained-utility/calibration/nonmember calls
query_streams.claim: source-only check observes no repeated initialized PCG64 state in this finite domain; does not prove mathematical or statistical independence
query_streams.coordinates: unsigned 32-bit integer coordinates; reject unknown roles, booleans, nonintegers and values outside [0, 2^32)
query_streams.preserved: original actual data and parameter initializations, noise scales and numbers of variants

resource_caps.abort_policy: external launcher enforces phase timeout; full assignments and each start/end/failure boundary are flush/fsync JSONL events. After producer exit, unmatched starts are interrupted and unstarted assignments remain missing; no complete seal, in-place repair or rerun
resource_caps.candidate_selection: one fixed candidate per method/request; all accepted for experimental audit without semantic admission
resource_caps.numerical_training: binary64 NumPy full-batch Adam; beta1 .9 beta2 .999 epsilon 1e-8; no weight decay

source_amendment.status: original prepared source retained unchanged; amended source requires new independent review and root authentication before launch

status: source-only amendment to the original prepared pilot; no predictor execution preceded this amendment
